Title: Borehole reinforcement & monitoring
Description: Weekly yield checks on existing boreholes; pre-position water trucks at regional depot.
Notes: Pilot tested in Lavumisa, Big Bend, Siphofaneni 2023/24 season.

Title: Water-trucking pre-positioning
Description: Stage emergency water trucks at the nearest regional depot; activate fuel allocation.

Title: Livestock-offtake subsidy activation
Description: Open the destocking window; MoA buying station at community hall with transport coordination.
Resources required: E480k budget · buying station · weighing kit
Source document: MoA Drought Response Protocol, Annex C

Title: Seed distribution for next planting
Description: Distribute drought-tolerant seed packs (sorghum, millet) to rain-fed smallholder households.
Source document: MoA Drought Response Protocol, Annex D
Notes: Coordinate with school holidays for distribution logistics.

Title: Rangeland rest rotation
Description: Close two grazing blocks for 60 days under traditional authority enforcement.
Notes: Enforcement depends on traditional authority cooperation.

Title: Activate Inkhundla DRMC
Description: Stand up the Inkhundla Disaster Risk Management Committee; weekly situational meetings.
Resources required: Meeting venue · per diems · comms kit
Notes: Per-diem rates set annually by Treasury circular.

Title: Social-protection seasonal top-up
Description: Activate seasonal cash supplement under existing social-protection envelope for vulnerable households.
Resources required: E230k from existing envelope · enrolment lists
